cds.title: Mount Holyoke College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Office of Institutional Research)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 4,619 applied, 1,774 admitted (38.4%), 536 enrolled. Residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international / unknown) add up to the totals (applicants also include 5 of unknown residence); international by address at application: 1,749 applied, 348 admitted, 129 enrolled. The CDS prints a second, unlabeled enrolled row (86 / 310 / 129 = 525) under a note that the first row includes 8 'citizens abroad'; the 536 row is used. Mount Holyoke is a women's college. Early decision: 411 applications, 208 admitted (the CDS lists ED closing dates Nov 15 and Jan 5 but gives one count). Waitlist: 474 offered, 196 accepted, 9 admitted. SAT/ACT submission is optional: 15% (83 students) submitted SAT and 2% (10) ACT, so the ACT percentiles rest on very few students. The GPA breakdown covers all enrolled students. Undergraduate enrollment (2,126) and nonresident (417) are degree-seeking undergraduates from B1/B2 (all undergraduates 2,135; nonresidents 422).

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1, G5), matching Mount Holyoke's Tuition and Fees page: tuition $71,178, student activity fee $272, housing $10,836 and food $10,760 (CDS food and housing $21,596). The page prints a billed total of $93,046. Estimated expenses in the CDS: books $1,000, transportation $1,500, other $1,400 (the page shows books $1,000, travel $0-$1,500, personal $1,000). Health insurance is billed on top and is required for all international students and may not be waived (amount not stated on the page). Per-credit charge $2,224. CDS H6: need-based and non-need-based institutional aid is available to nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates; 257 received it, average $53,460.
